observations: Exact 741-aa sequence match to reviewed Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron bifunctional BioAB (UniProt Q8A7T2).
Bifunctional enzyme: KAPA aminotransferase forms DAPA in the SAM route; biotin synthase converts dethiobiotin to biotin by sulfur insertion.
Associated with biotin biosynthetic process; annotations include PLP binding, [4Fe-4S] and [2Fe-2S] cluster binding.
UniProt GO annotation indicates cytoplasm; this supports a bacterial cytoplasmic localization.
